plan-for-open-datum-signing.text: Three pull requests: the first changes behaviour and is stacked on issue 641; the second and third move pages and harnesses. No on-chain change.

pull-request-1-open-datum-writes-end-in-.text: The first pull request has three slices, each starting from the issue 641 checkpoint it needs.

slice-1-the-command-line-names-the-signe.text: Slice one: the four writes accept the address with the bundle file, previews and inspect refuse the bundle file, the usage and the settings table name the external signer. A complete external line stops with the shared refusal until staging lands.

slice-2-external-mode.text: Slice two: each write ends in one bundle and status 19, refusals write no bundle, and open-datum states its own staged fields as expected. Create joins when the registry create stages, and the pending bundle row when the journal phase lands.

slice-3-vault-mode.text: Slice three: the same commands with the vault land, with one passphrase and receipts stated as fact once the bundle is on chain.

pull-request-2-demo-1-on-the-devnet.text: The second pull request moves the Demo 1 journey and its run page to wallets from singular wallet create, and teaches the devnet to fund a given address.

pull-request-3-the-guides.text: The third pull request moves the remaining guides to the vault; retiring open-datum's key file moved to issue 672.

neighbours-and-order.text: Issue 641 gates slices two and three; issue 672 retires the key file from the registry and from open-datum, and rebases on the second and third pull requests.

gate-and-budget.text: Every gate row is a hosted command, run under a memory and time bound. Slice one is bounded at 45 minutes, slices two and three at 90.
